taxjar_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs each time an exempt customer is added in TaxJar. Ones added before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

taxjar_new_order_trigger.description: Runs each time an order is reported in TaxJar. Ones reported before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

taxjar_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs each time a refund is reported in TaxJar. Ones reported before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
